_note: The studio's own portfolio (owner decisions: _ref/specs/DARK-THEME.md 'Client update 7', plan: _ref/specs/PORTFOLIO-PLAN.md).
A project is shown on the site only when scripts/media-manifest.json has its stills (run prepare_media.py, then build.py).

title: the name exactly as the site's info.txt / capture-report.json gives it; the manifest's info.txt name wins when present, unless keep_title is true: then the curated title (the site's own README / page title) wins - the owner's personal sites (gireesh-portfolio, gireesh-desk, gireesh-cinematic) are all named 'Gireesh' by their info.txt.
industry: short and factual, from the capture report's site_is ('verified': true) - unverified labels are the owner's draft and must be checked against the capture report once the site is captured.

services: default Website Design + Website Development; 'E-commerce' for the owner's shops (derlin-haus, mahira-select, siaara, vyrn: owner confirmed 14 Oct, DARK-THEME.md 'Client update 8' and its 23:20 decisions) and nowhere else (check.py) - not Sedile's demo cart either (owner default, 15 Oct).

Heeding and StepAI are excluded by the owner and must never be added. vyrn (VYRN) is a Concept Project since the owner's 14 Oct decision; its launch film also plays on the home laptop (home_laptop, home_laptop_clip).

label (owner, 14 Oct, DARK-THEME.md 'Client update 8'): shown on every Work card, project page head, home tile and service-card caption. 'Client Project' for all client work; 'Interactive Concept' (one-piece), 'Concept Project' (aaradhya, tavra, velora, saanjh, vesper, vyrn, thenga, sedile) or 'Personal project' (gireesh-portfolio, gireesh-desk, gireesh-cinematic) for the concepts group. label_note: the small secondary line under an Interactive Concept built on someone else's brand or IP ('Unofficial, not affiliated with the rights holders' / '... with the brand'). fan: true = a fan piece on film/TV/anime IP (keeps the Work page's fan-project sentence). scripts/check.py enforces the labels.

scene: device-scene backdrop (lib.SCENE_STYLES: red-horizon, blue-studio, stone-red, white-glass, grey-wall, violet-rock, violet-white, green-white, sky-white, amber-rock) or null = shown as plain images (Geetha Jewellers, owner). device: monitor | laptop. scene_still: the gallery still on the Work card's screen (default gallery-01). spill: tint of the light the screen throws on the surface. scene_confirmed: false = provisional pairing, to be chosen from the capture's colours when it arrives.

skip: roles not shown on the site - gallery stills ('gallery-NN') and the recordings ('laptop' = the device-scene clip on the project page, 'hero' = the phone clip on a home tile; without them the scene shows the Work still and the tile a still); remove an entry to show it again. skip_note says why.

home_laptop_clip: the recording the home laptop ('The Idea') plays when home_laptop lists the project, even when skip keeps it off the project page. Owner, 15 Oct: VYRN's launch film (vyrn/laptop.mp4) opens on the A-COLD-WALL hero; it stays on the home laptop (his choice) while the VYRN project page shows clean stills only (skip 'laptop').
alt: per-still alt text overrides ({"gallery-04": "..."}) for capture-report 'shows' lines that carry capture notes or private names (the capture reports themselves are read-only).
Every project the owner removed (DARK-THEME.md) is listed in projects.EXCLUDED and check.py FORBIDDEN: never add one back here, in home_gallery / home_laptop or in C:/Teseract-media/order.txt.

card_clip / tile_clip: a named loop clip of the project's media folder (prepare_media.py: <name>.mp4 + its <name>.png poster) played muted, looped and inline, only while in view (poster under reduced motion / Save-Data): card_clip = on the Work card's screen (the one card that autoplays), tile_clip = its home hero tile (instead of the hero.mp4 phone scroll). Owner, 14 Oct: Aivinci's profile = the tiger from aivinci.ai's 'AI Video Story' section (aivinci/tiger.mp4 + tiger.png); its project page keeps the laptop scene video. Owner, 14 Oct (later): the tiger must read as the website, not a zoomed video - tiger.mp4 is a 16:9 desktop view of the whole section (header, heading, panel with the tiger at its size in the page, intro line), never a crop of the video alone. The card_clip's poster (<name>.png) is the project's profile image wherever a still stands for it (owner, 15 Oct: Aivinci's Client Stories card shows the tiger poster, the same still as its Work card; alt text: alt '<name>-poster').

home_gallery: the projects of the home hero gallery's 20 tiles (sections/home_hero.COLUMNS: 4 columns x 5 slots, up to 6 clips), one tile each.
